_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base-rate dominates: muted 30d momentum, flat funding, dead ETF flows and diverging mini-top factors keep the score inside the Complacency band unless a named breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency coil; narrative silent on forward phase, only flow snapshot
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 47-54 with 30d momentum muted, funding near flat, ETF flows still dead
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G >62 with surging momentum and ETF inflows, or F&G <39 on funding flush and VIX spike
